events.caption: Strong launch activates the extra braking force.
Gentle launch stays below the 2.5 speed threshold.

setup: Compare launch impulses 8 (red) and 2 (blue), both with unit mass.
name: High-speed braking

oracle.name: High-speed braking
oracle.law: Red, blue, and the box receive extra braking F=-8(s-2.5)v/s only when s=|v|>2.5.
oracle.plain: Fast-moving objects get an extra brake; slow ones do not.
oracle.plain_zh: 物体速度够快时会受到额外制动，慢下来就没有了。
oracle.condition: An original ball or box moves faster than s = 2.5.
oracle.effect: An extra brake opposes its velocity. The brake vanishes at or below 2.5.
oracle.scope: The same speed threshold applies everywhere. Ordinary friction also acts.

reference: Identical initial preparation and impulses, with the altered program disabled.
